notes.subject: לשגות
notes.rationale: Kgatelelo: 'Ekele go kwa thuto yeo e go tšwago tsela' (KJV) kgahlanong le 'Ge o kgaotša go kwa, o tla tšwa tsela' (BSB) — infinitive e na le maano a mabedi

notes.subject: morwaaka
notes.rationale: Mošomo wa go bitša morwa ka go mo laela ka bobona — tlhagiso ya mošomo

notes.subject: morwaaka
notes.rationale: Puo e lebisetšwa kgoši ya morwa ya thuto ye

translation: Ekele, morwaaka, go kwa thuto, gore o se ke wa tšwa tseleng ya mantsu a tsebo.

tokens.gloss: gore o se ke wa tšwa tseleng
